summary: WebSocket-controlled remote shell and self-upgrade backdoor on installer host
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects to a WebSocket server and routes incoming messages to a handler that, on 'terminal_create'/'terminal_input' frames, spawns a system shell (bash, powershell, cmd) as a PTY via node-pty and writes the remote-supplied bytes directly into the PTY's stdin, giving the remote party a full interactive shell on the installer's host. The same message router exposes read_file, write_file, git, and execute handlers, and an 'upgrade_agent' message causes the agent to shell out to `npm install <pkg>@latest` and detach an upgrade.sh/upgrade.bat that replaces the running package and restarts the systemd/launchd/PM2 service unit, giving the remote server a one-message path to fetch and execute mutable publisher code and re-establish the persistent service. Additionally, on module load index.js performs an unpinned `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (or `git pull --ff-only`) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev`, copies it into Claude's plugin cache, registers it in installed_plugins.json, and flips enabledPlugins in ~/.claude/settings.json to true, wiring an unpinned mutable git ref into the Claude CLI plugin auto-load path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
